episodes.title: TRUE CRIME OBSESSED | MODERN CULTS | Love Has Won To Jesus Camp
episodes.description:
Ring the garbage bell, TCO fam! 🔔🗑️ Grab your wine and prepare to have your mind completely blown, because today we are diving into the most bizarre, infuriating, and terrifying MODERN CULTS ever captured on film!Welcome back to the True Crime Obsessed Archive! In this special compilation, Patrick Hinds and Gillian Pensavalle unpack the shocking power of brainwashing across three vastly different, yet equally insane documentaries.We kick things off with the absolute internet madness of "Love Has Won: The Cult of Mother God". Get ready for Patrick and Gillian to lose their minds over colloidal silver, galactic federations, and one of the wildest cult leaders of the digital age. Next, we take a dark and enraging turn with "Jesus Camp", where Gillian unleashes her righteous fury against the extreme indoctrination of children. Finally, we time-travel to the bizarre 1970s Hollywood health-food scene with the polygamous, rock-band-playing leader Father Yod in "The Source Family".   Expect loud screams, legendary rants, mind-boggling twists, and zero tolerance for garbage cult leaders. Let the women do the work! 🍷🛸
